muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿إذا وقعت الواقعة﴾: «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) of future time containing the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its implied (muqaddar) apodosis; there are other possibilities in its i'rab. «وقعت» is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; «الواقعة» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma; the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: «خفضت أقوامًا ورفعت آخرين» (it lowered some peoples and raised others); and the conditional clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ليس لوقعتها كاذبة﴾: «ليس» is an inert (jāmid), defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; «لوقعتها» is its fronted khabar (predicate), and the lām is in the sense of «في» (in), on the assumption of an implied muḍāf; «كاذبة» is the noun of «ليس». «كاذبة» is a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. «نفس كاذبة» (a lying soul); and it has been said: «كاذبة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that has come in the form of an active participle, meaning «الكذب» (lying).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿خافضة رافعة﴾: «خافضة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and «رافعة» is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إذا رجت الأرض رجا﴾: «إذا» is a badal (substitute) of the first «إذا», or a tawkīd (emphasis) of it, or its khabar (predicate) on the view that it [the first «إذا»] is a mubtadaʾ (subject), or it is conditional; the governing word in it is either implied (muqaddar) or the verb that follows it. «رجت» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; «الأرض» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); «رجًّا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb); and the clause «رجت» is in the position of a genitive.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿وبست الجبال بسا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «بست» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; «الجبال» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); «بسًّا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb); and the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿فكانت هباء منبثا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «كانت» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» (it); «هباء» is its khabar (predicate), and «منبثًّا» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «هباء».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وكنتم أزواجا ثلاثة﴾: conjoined to «رجت»; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, «أزواجًا» is its khabar (predicate), and «ثلاثة» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أزواجًا».

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿فأصحاب الميمنة ما أصحاب الميمنة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), to begin detailing and explaining the states of the three kinds; «أصحاب الميمنة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ما» is interrogative, in the position of a nominative as a second mubtadaʾ; the second «أصحاب الميمنة» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; and the clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ. Repeating the mubtadaʾ here in its own wording makes the linking element (rābiṭ), namely the pronoun, unnecessary.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وأصحاب المشأمة ما أصحاب المشأمة﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿والسابقون السابقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «السابقون» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and [the second] «السابقون» is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿أولئك المقربون﴾: «أولئك» is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «المقربون» is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw, or a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; the clause is the khabar of «السابقون», and the demonstrative makes the linking element (rābiṭ), namely the pronoun, unnecessary.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿في جنات النعيم﴾: a second khabar (predicate), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «المقربون», or attached to (mutaʿalliq) it.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿ثلة من الأولين﴾: «ثلة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هم ثلة من الأولين» (they are a large company of the former peoples), and «من الأولين» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وقليل من الآخرين﴾: «قليل» is conjoined to «ثلة», and «من الآخرين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قليل». And it has been said: «ثلة» is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) because it is qualified, and the khabar (predicate) is «على سرر» which comes next.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿على سرر موضونة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هم»; «موضونة» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سرر», genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿متكئين عليها متقابلين﴾: «متكئين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in the khabar «على سرر», accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a masculine plural; «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متكئين»; and «متقابلين» is a second ḥāl, accusative.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿يطوف عليهم ولدان مخلدون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يطوف»; «ولدان» is the fāʿil (agent), and «مخلدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ولدان».

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿بأكواب وأباريق وكأس من معين﴾: «بأكواب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يطوف», and what comes after it is conjoined to it; «من معين» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «الكأس».

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليهم». «لا» is negative; «يصدعون» is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «عنها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; and «لا ينزفون» is conjoined to «لا يصدعون».

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وفاكهة مما يتخيرون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; «مما» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فاكهة», and the clause «يتخيرون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ولحم طير مما يشتهون﴾: «لحم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «فاكهة», genitive (majrūr), and «طير» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «لحم»; «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a genitive; «يشتهون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وحور عين﴾: it is read in the nominative, and there are several views on it. The first: it is conjoined to «ولدان». The second: it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. «لهم حور» (they have ḥūr). The third: it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «ونساؤهم حور» (and their women are ḥūr). It is read in the accusative on the implied form «يعطون، أو يجازون حورًا» (they are given, or rewarded with, ḥūr). And it is read in the genitive, conjoined to «أكواب» in wording but not in meaning, because the ḥūr are not carried round [to them]; and it has been said: it is conjoined to «جنات», i.e. «في جنات وفي حور» (in gardens and among ḥūr). «عين» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «حور».

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿كأمثال اللؤلؤ المكنون﴾: in «كأمثال» the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as a second naʿt (adjective) of «حور»; «أمثال» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «اللؤلؤ» is muḍāf ilayhi, and «المكنون» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿جزاء بما كانوا يعملون﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. for the sake of reward, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «يجزون جزاء» (they are rewarded with a reward). «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جزاء»; the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يعملون» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تأثيما﴾: «لا» is negative; «يسمعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسمعون»; «لغوًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negative, and «تأثيمًا» is conjoined to «لغوًا».

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿إلا قيلا سلاما سلاما﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception, and the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ); «قيلًا» is a disjoined excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), necessarily accusative. As for «سلامًا سلامًا», there are several views on it. The first: it is a badal (substitute) of «قيلًا», i.e. they hear nothing in it except «سلامًا سلامًا». The second: it is a naʿt (adjective) of «قيلًا». The third: it is made accusative by «قيلًا», because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. except that they say «سلامًا سلامًا». The fourth: it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «سلموا سلامًا» (they gave greetings of peace).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وأصحاب اليمين ما أصحاب اليمين﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «أصحاب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; «أصحاب اليمين» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; and the clause is the khabar of «أصحاب».

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿في سدر مخضود﴾: a second khabar (predicate) of «أصحاب», or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هم في سدر» (they are among lote-trees); «مخضود» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سدر».

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿وطلح منضود﴾: a second khabar (predicate) of «أصحاب», or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هم في سدر», and «مخضود» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سدر». [Translator's note: this text repeats the comment on the previous ayah (56:28) word for word and does not treat «طلح» or «منضود»; presumably «طلح» is conjoined to «سدر» and «منضود» is a naʿt of «طلح», as with the following ayahs.]

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وظل ممدود﴾: conjoined to His saying «في سدر», and «ممدود» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وماء مسكوب﴾: conjoined to His saying «في سدر», and «مسكوب» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وفاكهة كثيرة﴾: conjoined to His saying «في سدر», and «كثيرة» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿لا مقطوعة ولا ممنوعة﴾: conjoined to His saying «في سدر», and the «لا» in «لا مقطوعة» is for negation. [Translator's note: «لا مقطوعة ولا ممنوعة» qualifies «فاكهة» in the preceding ayah; the source's «conjoined to في سدر» is translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وفرش مرفوعة﴾: conjoined to His saying «في سدر», and «مرفوعة» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿إنا أنشأناهن إنشاء﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, the clause «أنشأناهن» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «إنشاء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فجعلناهن أبكارا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «جعلناهن» is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أبكارًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿لأصحاب اليمين﴾: «لأصحاب اليمين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنشأناهن».

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿ثلة من الأولين﴾: «ثلة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من الأولين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ثلة».

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وثلة من الآخرين﴾: «ثلة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first «ثلة», nominative (marfūʿ); «من الآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «ثلة».

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وأصحاب الشمال ما أصحاب الشمال﴾: «أصحاب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; «أصحاب الشمال» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; the clause is the khabar of «أصحاب»; and the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿في سموم وحميم﴾: a second khabar (predicate), or the khabar of an implied (muḍmar) mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وظل من يحموم﴾: «ظل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سموم», genitive (majrūr); «من يحموم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «ظل».

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿لا بارد ولا كريم﴾: conjoined to what precedes, and the «لا» in «لا بارد» is for negation.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and the clause «كانوا» is its khabar (predicate); «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to «مترفين»; and «مترفين» is the khabar of «كان».

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وكانوا يصرون على الحنث العظيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يصرون» is its khabar (predicate); «على الحنث» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصرون»; and «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وكانوا يقولون أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أئنا لمبعوثون﴾: also conjoined. «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يقولون» is its khabar (predicate). The hamza is for interrogation; «إذا» is a conditional adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) something indicated by His saying «أئنا لمبعوثون»; «متنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «كنا» is conjoined to «متنا»; «كان» is a defective past verb, «نا» is its noun, «ترابًا» is its khabar, and «عظامًا» is conjoined to «ترابًا». The hamza is for interrogation; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مبعوثون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿أوآباؤنا الأولون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and the wāw is a conjunction; «آباؤنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun latent in «مبعوثون». Conjoining to the pronoun without the emphasis «نحن» is acceptable because of the separating element, namely the hamza. And it has been said: what it is conjoined to is the position of «إن» and its noun, after taking into account that the conjoined word has been placed before the khabar (predicate), the implied form being: «أئنا أو آباؤنا مبعوثون» (shall we, or our fathers, be raised?). «الأولون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آباؤنا».

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قل إن الأولين والآخرين﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «قل» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «الأولين» is its noun, «الآخرين» is conjoined to «الأولين», and «الآخرين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الأولين». [Translator's note: the source states the last point twice; both are translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿لمجموعون إلى ميقات يوم معلوم﴾: [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «مجموعون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «إن» with its noun and khabar is in the position of an accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying); «إلى ميقات يوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مجموعون»; and «معلوم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ثم إنكم أيها الضالون المكذبون﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay, falling within the scope of the saying; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «كم» is its noun; «أي» is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); «الضالون» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «أي», and «المكذبون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الضالون».

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿لآكلون من شجر من زقوم﴾: [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «آكلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنكم»; «من شجر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آكلون»; and «من زقوم» is a badal (substitute) of His saying «من شجر», or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), or a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿فمالئون منها البطون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «مالئون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «آكلون»; «منها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مالئون»; and «البطون» is the object of the active participle.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فشاربون عليه من الحميم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «شاربون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «آكلون»; «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «من الحميم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شاربون».

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿فشاربون شرب الهيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «شاربون» is conjoined to what precedes; «شرب» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «الهيم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿هذا نزلهم يوم الدين﴾: «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «نزلهم» is the khabar (predicate), and «يوم الدين»: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿نحن خلقناكم فلولا تصدقون﴾: «نحن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «خلقناكم» is the khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «تصدقون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿أفرأيتم ما تمنون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction; «رأيتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ما» is a relative noun in the sense of «الذي» (that which), the first object of «رأيتم»; and the clause «تمنون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿أأنتم تخلقونه أم نحن الخالقون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the pronoun of address is in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «تخلقون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the second object of the verb «رأيتم». As for «أم», it has been said that it is disjoined (munqaṭiʿa), because what follows it is a clause, so the meaning is «بل أنحن الخالقون» (nay, is it We who are the creators?), on the view that the interrogation is for eliciting affirmation (taqrīr); and it has been said: it is connected (muttaṣila). «نحن» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and «الخالقون» is the khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين﴾: «نحن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «قدرنا» is the khabar (predicate). «قدرنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). «بينكم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدرنا», and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «الموت» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «وما»: the wāw is a conjunction, or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like «ليس». «نحن» is the noun of «ما». «بمسبوقين»: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and «مسبوقين» is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in wording. The clause «ما نحن بمسبوقين» is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it, or parenthetical; on either view it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿على أن نبدل أمثالكم وننشئكم في ما لا تعلمون﴾: «على» is a preposition; «أن نبدل» is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive (majrūr) by «على»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسبوقين», or attached to «قدرنا بينكم», [in which case] the clause «وما نحن بمسبوقين» is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). «وننشئكم» is conjoined to «نبدل»; «فيما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ننشئكم»; and the clause «لا تعلمون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿ولقد علمتم النشأة الأولى فلولا تذكرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «علمتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «النشأة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «الأولى» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «لقد علمتم...» has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the implied oath, and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «فلولا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «تذكرون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿أفرأيتم ما تحرثون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «رأيتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «تحرثون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; the clause «تحرثون» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿أأنتم تزرعونه أم نحن الزارعون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the pronoun of address is in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «تزرعونه» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the second object of the verb «رأيتم». As for «أم», it has been said that it is disjoined (munqaṭiʿa), because what follows it is a clause, so the meaning is «بل أنحن الزارعون» (nay, is it We who are the growers?), on the view that the interrogation is for eliciting affirmation (taqrīr); and it has been said: it is connected (muttaṣila). «نحن» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and «الزارعون» is the khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿لو نشاء لجعلناه حطاما﴾: «لو» is conditional; «نشاء» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن» (We); the lām occurs in the answer of «لو»; «جعلناه» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «حطامًا» is the second object of «جعل»; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فظلتم تفكهون﴾: «ظلتم» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تفكهون» is its khabar (predicate); «تفكهون» is an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿إنا لمغرمون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مغرمون» is its khabar (predicate). The clause of «إن» with its noun and khabar is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an omitted [verb of] saying, in the position of an accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: «فظللتم تفكهون، قائلين: إنا لمغرمون» (and you would remain wondering, saying: we are indeed burdened with debt).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿بل نحن محرومون﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; «نحن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «محرومون» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿أفرأيتم الماء الذي تشربون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «رأيتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «الماء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «الذي» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «الماء»; the clause «تشربون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿أأنتم أنزلتموه من المزن أم نحن المنزلون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the pronoun of address is in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «أنزلتموه» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the wāw is for prolongation (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «من المزن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلتموه», in the position of an accusative as the second object of «رأيتم»; and «أنزلتموه» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم». [Translator's note: the phrase «in the position of an accusative as the second object of رأيتم» presumably refers to the nominal clause «أأنتم أنزلتموه», as in the parallel entries on 56:59 and 56:64, not to «من المزن»; translated as written.] As for «أم», it has been said that it is disjoined (munqaṭiʿa), because what follows it is a clause, so the meaning is «بل أنحن المنزلون» (nay, is it We who send it down?), on the view that the interrogation is for eliciting affirmation (taqrīr); and it has been said: it is connected (muttaṣila). «نحن» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and «المنزلون» is the khabar, nominative with the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿لو نشاء جعلناه أجاجا فلولا تشكرون﴾: «لو» is a particle of impossibility for impossibility (imtināʿ li-imtināʿ); «نشاء» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is «نحن» (We); «جعلناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «أجاجًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi. The clause «جعلناه» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, and the conditional clause «لو نشاء جعلناه أجاجا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «فلولا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ); «تشكرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿أفرأيتم النار التي تورون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «رأيتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «النار» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «التي» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «النار»; the clause «تورون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿أأنتم أنشأتم شجرتها﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the pronoun of address is in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «أنشأتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «شجرة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ها» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
﴿أم نحن المنشئون﴾: as for «أم», it has been said that it is disjoined (munqaṭiʿa), because what follows it is a clause, so the meaning is «بل أنحن المنشئون» (nay, is it We who produce it?), on the view that the interrogation is for eliciting affirmation (taqrīr); and it has been said: it is connected (muttaṣila). «نحن» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and «المنشئون» is the khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿نحن جعلناها تذكرة ومتاعا للمقوين﴾: «نحن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «جعلناها» is the khabar (predicate); «تذكرة» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «متاعًا» is conjoined to «تذكرة»; and «للمقوين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متاعًا», or a ṣifa (adjective) of it.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿فسبح باسم ربك العظيم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of eloquence, pointing to an omitted condition); «سبح» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is «أنت» (you); «باسم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سبح», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «متبرِّكًا» (seeking blessing); and it has been said: «اسم» is inserted (muqḥam). «العظيم» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «ربك».

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «لا» is redundant (ṣila); and it has been said: it is negative, and what is negated is omitted; and it has been said: it is the lām of the beginning (lām al-ibtidāʾ), which has entered a clause made of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), namely «أنا أقسم» (I swear), as in your saying «لزيد منطلق» (Zayd is surely departing); then the mubtadaʾ was omitted and the lām became joined to its khabar, the implied form being «فلأقسم», with the lām alone. And it has been said: it is a lām whose fatḥa was prolonged, so that an alif was generated from it. «أقسم» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنا» (I); «بمواقع النجوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقسم».

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «قسم» is its khabar (predicate). «لو» is conditional. «تعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). «عظيم» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «قسم». The clause «لو تعلمون» is parenthetical between the qualified noun and its adjective, with no grammatical position. The clause «إنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم» is parenthetical between the oath and its answer, with no grammatical position. The apodosis of «لو» is omitted, the implied form being: «لو كنتم من ذوي العلم لعلمتم» (if you were among those who have knowledge, you would know).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿إنه لقرآن كريم﴾: the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «قرآن» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنه», and «كريم» is a first ṣifa (adjective) of «قرآن».

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿في كتاب مكنون﴾: «في كتاب» is a second ṣifa (adjective) of «قرآن», and «مكنون» is a ṣifa of «كتاب».

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿لا يمسه إلا المطهرون﴾: «لا» is negative; «يمسه» is an imperfect verb and its object; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «المطهرون» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يمسه»; and the clause is a third ṣifa (adjective) of «قرآن». And it has been said: «لا» is prohibitive, and «يمسه» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا».

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿تنزيل من رب العالمين﴾: a fourth ṣifa (adjective), and «من رب العالمين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «تنزيل».

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿أفبهذا الحديث أنتم مدهنون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction; «بهذا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مدهنون»; «الحديث» is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; «أنتم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مدهنون» is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وتجعلون رزقكم أنكم تكذبون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تجعلون رزقكم»: [«تجعلون»] is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «رزقكم» is the first object of «تجعلون»; «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «كم» is its noun, and the clause «تكذبون» is its khabar (predicate); «أن» with what is in its scope is in the place of the second object. A muḍāf must be supplied, i.e. «شكر رزقكم» (the thanks for your provision).

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) in the sense of «هلا» (why not); the governing word in «إذا» is the verb that comes after «لولا», namely «ترجعونها»; «بلغت» is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «النفس» (the soul), i.e. when the soul reaches the throat at death. [Translator's note: the source calls the implied fāʿil «النفس», a noun; strictly the latent pronoun «هي» refers to it.]

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «أنتم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). «حينئذ»: «حين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تنظرون», and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn that is implied because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: «حين إذْ بلغت الروح الحلقوم» (at the time when the soul reached the throat). The clause «تنظرون» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم», and the clause «وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «بلغت».

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿ونحن أقرب إليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «نحن» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أقرب» is the khabar (predicate); «إليه» and «منكم» are prepositions with their genitive nouns, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقرب»; the wāw is a conjunction; «لكن» is lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala), for rectification (istidrāk); «لا» is negative; and «تبصرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿فلولا إن كنتم غير مدينين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) that emphasises ﴿لولا الأولى﴾ (the first «لولا»); «إن» is conditional; «كنتم»: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «غير مدينين» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿ترجعونها إن كنتم صادقين﴾: «ترجعونها» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and «ها» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إن» is conditional; «كنتم»: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «صادقين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿فأما إن كان من المقربين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «أمّا» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); «إن» is conditional; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), i.e. the deceased; «من المقربين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿فروح وريحان وجنة نعيم﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of «أما»; the apodosis (jawāb) of «إن» is omitted because what is mentioned indicates it, and omitting the apodosis of «إن» is very common. «روح» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted and placed before it, i.e. «فله روح» (then for him is rest), and what comes after it is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿وأما إن كان من أصحاب اليمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أمّا» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); «إن» is conditional; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he), i.e. the deceased; «من أصحاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «اليمين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is conjoined to the clause «فأما إن كان...».

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿فسلام لك من أصحاب اليمين﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of «أمّا», and the apodosis (jawāb) of «إنْ» is omitted because what is mentioned indicates it. «سلام» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «لك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; «من أصحاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar to which the preposition and its genitive noun «لك» are attached; and «اليمين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وأما إن كان من المكذبين الضالين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أمّا» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); «إن» is conditional; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he), i.e. the deceased; «من المكذبين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «الضالين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المكذبين», genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause is conjoined to the clause «فأما إن كان...».

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿فنزل من حميم﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of «أما»; «نزل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose fronted khabar (predicate) has been omitted, i.e. «فله نُزُل» (then for him is a reception); «من حميم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «نزل».

muyesser-irab:94-94.t: ﴿وتصلية جحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تصلية جحيم» is conjoined to «نزل», and «جحيم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿إن هذا لهو حق اليقين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «هذا» is its noun; [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); «حق اليقين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», or the khabar of «هو», [in which case] the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن». The annexation of «حق» to «اليقين» is an annexation of the qualified noun to its adjective.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t: ﴿فسبح باسم ربك العظيم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of eloquence, pointing to an omitted condition); «سبح» is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت» (you); «باسم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «سبح»; the word «رب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ربك».
